neighbours.label: the indefinite article that opens the category in a definition ('X is a / an …', 'defined as a …'), versus 'a' introducing an ordinary object in narration
fire: In geology, a delta is a landform made of sediment at a river mouth.
Simply put, a thermometer is an instrument that measures temperature.
Put simply, a budget is a plan for how money will be spent.
Botanists define a fern as a plant that reproduces by spores.
In chess, a gambit is an opening that sacrifices material for position.
By definition a lighthouse is a tower with a bright lamp that guides ships.
Legally, a contract is defined as an agreement that courts will enforce.
For students, an atlas is a book of maps covering many regions.
quiet: In geology class, we visited a delta near the river mouth last spring.
Last night my thermometer broke when I dropped it in the kitchen.
Put simply, our budget ran out before the end of the month.
On the hike, botanists found ferns growing on the shaded rocks.
In chess club, my brother lost his queen in the opening.
On Sunday we climbed the old lighthouse and watched ships pass.
Legally, the contract was signed by both parties in May.
Sadly, my atlas has torn pages and faded maps.
